material.description: The OECD definition describes formal registered organisations and informal associations and provides an illustrative basis for the Claim's organisational forms. The Claim's list is not exhaustive; the source does not establish identical legal personality, registration, rights or powers across jurisdictions.
material.locator: OECD/LEGAL/5021, Section I, definition of “CSOs”: not-for-profit, non-state, non-partisan, non-violent and self-governing organisations; formal registered organisations and informal associations without legal status.
